life.included: Ice bath recovery, cycling, outdoor activities, Wi-Fi and open kitchen access are included in Stay & Surf.

life.optional: Curious about kayaking? Ask about current options, price and conditions. It is not included in the listed packages; bioluminescence is never guaranteed.
life.independent: Beach sunsets, cafés or exploring the coast are independent outings. Arrange your own transport and budget for any entry fees.

faqs.question: I've never surfed. Where should I start?
faqs.answer: The 3-day course gives you a shorter introduction; 5 days gives you more time to practise and receive feedback. Instructor guidance and basic surf equipment are included in group courses. Tell the team your experience and water confidence before booking. Progress varies for every surfer.

faqs.question: Do I need to know how to swim?
faqs.answer: Discuss your swimming ability and water confidence with the team before booking. Ask about their participation requirements and safety arrangements. Ocean conditions vary, and surfing cannot be described as risk-free.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Surf Only and Stay & Surf?
faqs.answer: Surf Only is a course without accommodation, with a 2-hour group session, surfboard/basic equipment and instructor guidance. Arrange your own travel to the surf location. Stay & Surf adds the selected nights of accommodation, daily lessons, small-batch learning and the listed recovery and social inclusions. Meals remain optional additions.

faqs.question: Are meals included?
faqs.answer: No. Optional daily meals are Veg {{vegMealRate}}/day or Non-Veg {{nonVegMealRate}}/day. Confirm the number of meals, how many days you need and dietary options with the team. Stay & Surf includes open kitchen access.

faqs.question: How do payments and refunds work?
faqs.answer: Surf Only: {{surfOnlyPayment}} Stay & Surf: {{staySurfPayment}} Confirm the final total and availability directly with the team. This website does not take payments or reserve beds.

faqs.question: How does the weekday offer work?
faqs.answer: {{offerLabel}} {{offerTerms}} The team must confirm eligibility and whether the discount is per person or per booking.

faqs.question: Is the hostel on the surf beach?
faqs.answer: The stay is by the backwaters in Chitrapu Village, Mulki. The map here points to the stay. Ask the team to confirm the actual surf beach, travel arrangements and any transfer costs for your package.

faqs.question: Which room or tent will I stay in?
faqs.answer: Camping, Non-AC Hostel and AC Hostel are the listed options. Confirm current room allocation, sharing setup, bathrooms and amenities. Private rooms, bed counts, mixed dorms and camping equipment are not confirmed by these package labels.

faqs.question: What if the ocean conditions change?
faqs.answer: All surf sessions are subject to ocean and weather conditions. Ask the team how they handle changes for your dates before paying. No rescheduling or cancellation exception is promised here.

faqs.question: Can I work from the stay?
faqs.answer: Wi-Fi and open kitchen access are included in Stay & Surf. If your work needs dependable calls or specific bandwidth, ask about the current connection and power arrangements before booking.

faqs.question: Is kayaking or bioluminescence part of my package?
faqs.answer: Kayaking is not a listed inclusion. Ask about current options, separate pricing and conditions. Bioluminescence is a natural phenomenon and cannot be guaranteed. Evening social activities also vary during your stay.

seasons.title: Longer days. A slower pace.
seasons.text: March–May is within the wider beginner season described by local guides. As summer approaches, plan for the heat and confirm conditions with the team.
